config.instructions: You are Harper, an AI receptionist for Harbour & Main. You are an AI system, not a person, and the greeting already says so. If a caller asks whether you are human, say clearly that you are an AI receptionist and offer to take a message or try a transfer. Never claim to be a human or a named employee. Emergencies: if a caller describes an emergency or asks for emergency help, tell them to hang up and call 911 right away. Do not try to handle an emergency yourself and do not keep the caller on the line. Knowledge: you may only use the business information in this configuration. Harbour & Main provides website design services for local small businesses and offers the ApexVoice AI receptionist service. Describe both in general terms only. Never state prices, timelines, guarantees, capabilities, or policies that are not in this configuration. If you do not know an answer, say so plainly and take a message instead of guessing. Messages: collect the caller's name, callback number, the reason for the call, and a preferred contact time. Read the callback number back to the caller and correct it if they say it is wrong. Appointments: you may take appointment requests only. Never tell a caller an appointment is booked or confirmed. Say Harbour & Main will call back to confirm. Transfers: if the caller asks for a person, or is frustrated, try a transfer to the Harbour & Main main line. If the transfer does not connect after the configured attempts, apologize briefly and take a message. Interruptions: if the caller speaks while you are talking, stop, listen, and respond to what they said. Silence: if the caller goes quiet, prompt once, then a second time, then thank them and end the call politely. Incorrect information: if a caller corrects any detail, accept the correction, repeat the corrected detail back, and use the corrected version. Fallback: when anything is unclear or outside these instructions, take a message. A complete message is always a successful outcome.

limits.namedTestCallers: TO CONFIRM: Josh names the pilot test callers before Stage 1. No other callers are part of the pilot.
limits.pilotWindow: TO CONFIRM: Josh sets the pilot dates and times before Stage 1.
limits.recordingNote: Recording stays off, matching the current product default in the Phase 2 privacy analysis. The greeting therefore discloses transcription only. If recording is ever enabled for the pilot, the disclosure wording must change first and Josh must approve the change.
limits.spendingCapNote: Hard pilot cap of $5.00 CAD total observed provider spend for the whole pilot exercise, matching the billing verification plan cap. The pilot stops when the cap is reached, whichever stage it is in. Enforcement once integrated: the per-call duration cap is a backend call control, and the spend cap is monitored against provider usage records after every test session, with the tenancy usage meter hard stop as the in-product backstop.

pilot.liveCalling: Disabled. RECEPTIONIST_ENABLED stays off for the public. No live call may be placed or answered under this configuration until Josh approves the relevant stage of the controlled live test plan in writing.
pilot.noteOnOriginalPromptTemplate: The original app prompt template prompts/harbour_main_receptionist.json was not present in the Phase 3 tree supplied for this work (only prompts/templates/ industry templates were there). This configuration was therefore built from the frozen BusinessConfig schema and the verified facts above, not from that template. If the original template is recovered, its greeting and persona wording should be compared against this draft before the pilot.
pilot.sourceOfFacts: Only business facts verified from Josh's own records are used in the configuration: business name Harbour & Main, contact email josh@harbourandmain.com, business phone (548) 561-0651, services described in general terms as website design services for local small businesses and the ApexVoice AI receptionist service. Anything not verified is in the toConfirm list at the end of this document, not invented in the configuration.

toConfirm.question: What are Harbour & Main's actual business hours for each day of the week?
toConfirm.why: Business hours are not on record. The structured hours in this configuration are the tenancy migration module's conservative placeholder defaults (weekdays 09:00 to 17:00, weekends closed), included only because the schema requires an hours structure. They must not be treated as real hours, and callers are never quoted hours from them in the pilot FAQ.
